ayahs.textUthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Iqtaraba linnaasi hisaabuhum wahum fee ghaflatim mu'ridoon
ayahs.translationClear: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, but they turn away heedlessly.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ مُّحْدَثٍ اِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوْهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
ayahs.transliteration: Maa ya'teehim min dhikrim mir rabbihim muhdathin illastama'oohu wahum yal'aboon
ayahs.translationClear: No fresh reminder comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it playfully.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ‌ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ‌ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوْبُهُمْؕ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَيࣗۖ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْاࣗۖ هَلْ هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْۚ اَفَتَاْتُوْنَ السِّحْرَ وَاَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
ayahs.transliteration: Laahiyatan quloobuhum wa'asarrun-najwal-ladheena zalamoo hal haadhaa illaa basharum mithlukum afata'toonas-sihra wa'antum tubsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Their hearts distracted, the wrongdoers confer secretly, “Is this anything but a mortal like you? Will you take to sorcery, with open eyes?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قٰلَ رَبِّيْ يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ وَالْاَرْضِؗ وَهُوَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbee ya'lamul-qawla fis-samaa'i wal-ardi wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth; and He is the Hearer, the Knower.”

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ قَالُوْٓا اَضْغَاثُ اَحْلَامٍۭ بَلِ افْتَرٰىهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۚۖ فَلْيَاْتِنَا بِاٰيَةٍ كَمَا͏ٓ اُرْسِلَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
ayahs.transliteration: Bal qaaloo adghaathu ahlaamim baliftaraahu bal huwa shaa'irun falya'tinaa bi'aayatin kamaa ursilal-awwaloon
ayahs.translationClear: And they said, “A jumble of dreams,” and, “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet.” “Let him bring us a sign, like those sent to the ancients.”

ayahs.textUthmani: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ‌ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا͏ٓ اٰمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَاۚ اَفَهُمْ يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them,[872] so will they believe?
ayahs.transliteration: Maa aamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa afahum yu'minoon

footnotes.872: Even though they had witnessed signs and miracles.

ayahs.translationClear: None of the towns We destroyed before them had believed. Will they, then, believe?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ‌ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـٔ͏َلُوْٓا اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim fas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: We did not send before you except men, whom We inspired. Ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا جَعَلْنٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوْا خٰلِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food,[873] nor were they immortal [on earth].
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ja'alnaahum jasadal laa ya'kuloonat-ta'aama wamaa kaanoo khaalideen

footnotes.873: Like the angels. Rather, they were human beings with human attributes.

ayahs.translationClear: We did not make them mere bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنٰهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُمْ وَمَنْ نَّشَا࢜ءُ وَاَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then[874] We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma sadaqnaahumul-wa'da fa'anjaynaahum waman nashaa'u wa'ahlaknal-musrifeen

footnotes.874: Once they had conveyed the message.

ayahs.translationClear: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, and We saved them together with whomever We willed, and We destroyed the extravagant.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ‌ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدْ اَنْزَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكُمْ كِتٰبًا فِيْهِ ذِكْرُكُمْؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention.[875] Then will you not reason?
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad anzalnaa ilaykum kitaaban feehi dhikrukum afalaa ta'qiloon

footnotes.875: This implies the honor of having been mentioned or addressed. Another meaning is "your reminder."

ayahs.translationClear: We have sent down to you a Book, containing your message. Do you not understand?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَّاَنْشَاْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا اٰخَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And how many a city which was unjust[876] have We shattered and produced after it another people.
ayahs.transliteration: Wakam qasamnaa min qaryatin kaanat zaalimatan wa'ansha'naa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen

footnotes.876: i.e., its inhabitants persisting in wrongdoing.

ayahs.translationClear: How many a guilty town have We crushed, and established thereafter another people?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا͏ٓ اَحَسُّوْا بَاْسَنَا͏ٓ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa ahassoo ba'sanaa idhaa hum minhaa yarkudoon
ayahs.translationClear: Then, when they sensed Our might, they started running away from it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا تَرْكُضُوْا وَارْجِعُوْٓا اِلٰي مَا͏ٓ اُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيْهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـٔ͏َلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."[877]
ayahs.transliteration: Laa tarkudoo warji'oo ilaa maa utriftum feehi wamasaakinikum la'allakum tus'aloon

footnotes.877: About what happened to you. This is said to them in sarcasm and ridicule.

ayahs.translationClear: Do not run, but come back to your luxuries, and to your homes, that you may be questioned.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا يٰوَيْلَنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Woe to us; we were unfair.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَا زَالَتْ تِّلْكَ دَعْوٰىهُمْ حَتّٰي جَعَلْنٰهُمْ حَصِيْدًا خٰمِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
ayahs.transliteration: Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen
ayahs.translationClear: This continued to be their cry, until We made them silent ashes.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لٰعِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
ayahs.translationClear: We did not create the sky and the earth and what is between them for amusement.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْ اَرَدْنَا͏ٓ اَنْ نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّاتَّخَذْنٰهُ مِنْ لَّدُنَّا͏ٓࣗۖ اِنْ كُنَّا فٰعِلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had We intended to take a diversion,[878] We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
ayahs.transliteration: Law aradnaa an nattakhidha lahwal lattakhadhnaahu mil ladunnaa in kunnaa faa'ileen

footnotes.878: Such as a wife or a child.

ayahs.translationClear: If We wanted amusement, We could have found it within Us, were We to do so.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ‌ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَي الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهٗ فَاِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌؕ وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it,[879] and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.[880]
ayahs.transliteration: Bal naqdhifu bil-haqqi 'alal-baatili fayadmaghuhoo fa'idhaa huwa zaahiqun walakumul-waylu mimmaa tasifoon

footnotes.879: Literally, "strikes its brain," disabling or killing it.
footnotes.880: Of untruth concerning Allāh, particularly here, the claim that He has a son or other "partner" in divinity.

ayahs.translationClear: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it crushes it, so it vanishes. Woe unto you, for what you describe.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهٗ مَنْ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهٗ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهٖ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
ayahs.transliteration: Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi waman 'indahoo laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihee walaa yastahsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. Those near Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they waver.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يُسَبِّحُوْنَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
ayahs.transliteration: Yusabbihoonal-layla wan-nahaara laa yafturoon
ayahs.translationClear: They praise night and day, without ever tiring.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْٓا اٰلِهَةً مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ هُمْ يُنْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
ayahs.transliteration: Amittakhadhoo aalihatam minal-ardi hum yunshiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Or have they taken to themselves gods from the earth who resurrect?

ayahs.textUthmani: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا‌ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْ كَانَ فِيْهِمَا͏ٓ اٰلِهَةٌ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۚ فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: Law kaana feehimaa aalihatun illallaahu lafasadataa fasubhaanallaahi rabbil-'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
ayahs.translationClear: If there were in them gods other than Allah, they would have gone to ruin. So glory be to Allah, Lord of the Throne, beyond what they allege.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يُسْـٔ͏َلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـٔ͏َلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yus'alu 'ammaa yaf'alu wahum yus'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: He will not be questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً‌ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ‌ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى‌ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ‌ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اٰلِهَةًؕ قُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْۚ هٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَنْ مَّعِيَ وَذِكْرُ مَنْ قَبْلِيْؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَۙ الْحَقَّ فَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me."[881] But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Amittakhadhoo min doonihee aalihatan qul haatoo burhaanakum haadhaa dhikru mam ma'iya wadhikru man qablee bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoonal-haqqa fahum mu'ridoon

footnotes.881: All previous prophets called for the worship of Allāh alone.

ayahs.translationClear: Or have they taken, besides Him, other gods? Say, “Bring your proof. This is a message for those with me, and a message of those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا نُوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْهِ اَنَّهٗ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنَا فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika mir rasoolin illaa noohee ilayhi annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fa'budoon
ayahs.translationClear: We never sent a messenger before you without inspiring him that: “There is no god but I, so worship Me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا‌ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ‌ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبْحٰنَهٗؕ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they[882] are [but] honored servants.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaluttakhadhar-rahmaanu waladan subhaanahoo bal 'ibaadum mukramoon

footnotes.882: Those they claim to be "children" of Allāh, such as the angels, Ezra, Jesus, etc.

ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “The Most Merciful has taken to Himself a son.” Be He glorified; they are but honored servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَسْبِقُوْنَهٗ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِاَمْرِهٖ يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil-qawli wahum bi'amrihee ya'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: They never speak before He has spoken, and they only act on His command.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُوْنَۙ اِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضٰي وَهُمْ مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهٖ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,[883] and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yashfa'oona illaa limanirtadaa wahum min khashyatihee mushfiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them; and they do not intercede except for him whom He approves; and they tremble in awe of Him.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ يَّقُلْ مِنْهُمْ اِنِّيْٓ اِلٰهٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيْهِ جَهَنَّمَؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilaahum min doonihee fadhaalika najzeehi jahannama kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And whoever of them says, “I am a god besides Him,” We will reward him with Hell. Thus We reward the wrongdoers.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا‌ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنٰهُمَاؕ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَا࢜ءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّؕ اَفَلَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaral-ladheena kafaroo annas-samaawaati wal-arda kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaahumaa waja'alnaa minal-maa'i kulla shay'in hayyin afalaa yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: Do the disbelievers not see that the heavens and the earth were one mass, and We tore them apart? And We made from water every living thing. Will they not believe?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنَا فِي الْاَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنْ تَمِيْدَ بِهِمْࣕ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيْهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim waja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la'allahum yahtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: And We placed on earth stabilizers, lest it sways with them, and We placed therein signposts and passages, that they may be guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا‌ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَا࢜ءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوْظًاۚۖ وَّهُمْ عَنْ اٰيٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs,[884] are turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnas-samaa'a saqfam mahfoozan wahum 'an aayaatihaa mu'ridoon

footnotes.884: The signs present in the heavens.

ayahs.translationClear: And We made the sky a protected ceiling; yet they turn away from its wonders.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ‌ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَؕ كُلٌّ فِيْ فَلَكٍ يَّسْبَحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqal-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoon
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in an orbit.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ‌ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَؕ اَفَا۟ىِٕنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ja'alnaa libasharim min qablikal-khulda afa'im mitta fahumul-khaalidoon
ayahs.translationClear: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you. Should you die, are they then the immortal?

ayahs.textUthmani: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ‌ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً‌ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَا࢜ىِٕقَةُ الْمَوْتِؕ وَنَبْلُوْكُمْ بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًؕ وَاِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawti wanablookum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnatan wa'ilaynaa turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Every soul will taste death. We burden you with adversity and prosperity—a test. And to Us you will be returned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا رَاٰكَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ يَّتَّخِذُوْنَكَ اِلَّا هُزُوًاؕ اَهٰذَا الَّذِيْ يَذْكُرُ اٰلِهَتَكُمْۚ وَهُمْ بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa ra'aakal-ladheena kafaroo in yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwan ahaadhal-ladhee yadhkuru aalihatakum wahum bidhikrir-rahmaani hum kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: When those who disbelieve see you, they treat you only with ridicule: “Is this the one who mentions your gods?” And they reject the mention of the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ‌ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: خُلِقَ الْاِنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍؕ سَاُورِيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِيْ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.transliteration: Khuliqal-insaanu min 'ajalin sa'ureekum aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon
ayahs.translationClear: The human being was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not seek to rush Me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When will this promise come true, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا حِيْنَ لَا يَكُفُّوْنَ عَنْ وُّجُوْهِهِمُ النَّارَ وَلَا عَنْ ظُهُوْرِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...[885]
ayahs.transliteration: Law ya'lamul-ladheena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona 'an wujoohihimun-naara walaa 'an zuhoorihim walaa hum yunsaroon

footnotes.885: The completion of the sentence is understood to be "...they would not be asking in disbelief and ridicule to be shown the punishment."

ayahs.translationClear: If those who disbelieve only knew, when they cannot keep the fire off their faces and off their backs, and they will not be helped.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ تَاْتِيْهِمْ بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.transliteration: Bal ta'teehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa walaa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.translationClear: In fact, it will come upon them suddenly, and bewilder them. They will not be able to repel it, and they will not be reprieved.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدِ اسْتُهْزِي͏ٔ͏َ بِرُسُلٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالَّذِيْنَ سَخِرُوْا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fahaaqa bil-ladheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Messengers before you were also ridiculed, but those who jeered were surrounded by what they had ridiculed.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ‌ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ مَنْ يَّكْلَو͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمٰنِؕ بَلْ هُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul man yakla'ukum bil-layli wan-nahaari minar-rahmaani bal hum 'an dhikri rabbihim mu'ridoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Who guards you against the Merciful by night and by day?” But they turn away from the mention of their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا‌ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ لَهُمْ اٰلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِنَاؕ لَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ نَصْرَ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
ayahs.transliteration: Am lahum aalihatun tamna'uhum min dooninaa laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim walaa hum minnaa yus'haboon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they have gods who can defend them against Us? They cannot help themselves, nor will they be protected from Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ‌ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ‌ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ وَاٰبَا࢜ءَهُمْ حَتّٰي طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعُمُرُؕ اَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ اَنَّا نَاْتِي الْاَرْضَ نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ اَطْرَافِهَاؕ اَفَهُمُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?[886] Is it they who will overcome?
ayahs.transliteration: Bal matta'naa haa'ulaa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa taala 'alayhimul-'umuru afalaa yarawna annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa afahumul-ghaaliboon
ayahs.translationClear: We have given these enjoyments, and their ancestors, until time grew long upon them. Do they not see how We gradually reduce the land from its extremities? Are they then the victors?

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ‌ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اُنْذِرُكُمْ بِالْوَحْيِؗۖ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعَا࢜ءَ اِذَا مَا يُنْذَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamaa undhirukum bil-wahyi walaa yasma'us-summud-du'aa'a idhaa maa yundharoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “I am warning you through inspiration.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are being warned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَىِٕنْ مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ يٰوَيْلَنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Wala'im massat'hum nafhatum min 'adhaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And when a breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they say, “Woe to us, we were truly wicked.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا‌ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا‌ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِيْنَ الْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـٔ͏ًاؕ وَاِنْ كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ اَتَيْنَا بِهَاؕ وَكَفٰي بِنَا حٰسِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed,[887] We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanada'ul-mawaazeenal-qista liyawmil-qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shay'an wa'in kaana mithqaala habbatim min khardalin ataynaa bihaa wakafaa binaa haasibeen

footnotes.887: i.e., anything as small or insignificant as a mustard seed.

ayahs.translationClear: We will set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so that no soul will suffer the least injustice. And even if it be the weight of a mustard-seed, We will bring it up. Sufficient are We as Reckoners.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسٰي وَهٰرُوْنَ الْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَا࢜ءً وَّذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder[888] for the righteous
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa moosaa wahaaroonal-furqaana wadiyaa'an wadhikral lilmuttaqeen

footnotes.888: These are three qualities of the Torah.

ayahs.translationClear: We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion, and illumination, and a reminder for the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِّنَ السَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who fear their Lord unseen,[889] while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum minas-saa'ati mushfiqoon

footnotes.889: Which can mean "Him being unseen" by them or "though they are unseen" by others.

ayahs.translationClear: Those who fear their Lord in private, and are apprehensive of the Hour.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ‌ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبٰرَكٌ اَنْزَلْنٰهُؕ اَفَاَنْتُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?[890]
ayahs.transliteration: Wahaadhaa dhikrum mubaarakun anzalnaahu afa'antum lahoo munkiroon

footnotes.890: i.e., pretending ignorance, disapproving or refusing to acknowledge it?

ayahs.translationClear: This too is a blessed message that We revealed. Are you going to deny it?

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا͏ٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ رُشْدَهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهٖ عٰلِمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before,[891] and We were of him well-Knowing
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu wakunnaa bihee 'aalimeen

footnotes.891: i.e., before Moses. Allāh had guided him from early youth.

ayahs.translationClear: We gave Abraham his integrity formerly, and We knew him well.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيْلُ الَّتِيْٓ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا عٰكِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
ayahs.transliteration: Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maa haadhihit-tamaatheelul-latee antum lahaa 'aakifoon
ayahs.translationClear: When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoted?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا وَجَدْنَا͏ٓ اٰبَا࢜ءَنَا لَهَا عٰبِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo wajadnaa aabaa'anaa lahaa 'aabideen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We found our parents worshiping them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ اَنْتُمْ وَاٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa'aabaa'ukum fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “You and your parents are in evident error.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اَجِي͏ٔ͏ْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ اَمْ اَنْتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo aji'tanaa bil-haqqi am anta minal-laa'ibeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Are you telling us the truth, or are you just playing?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ بَلْ رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ الَّذِيْ فَطَرَهُنَّؗۖ وَاَنَا عَلٰي ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala bal rabbukum rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardil-ladhee fatarahunna wa'ana 'alaa dhaalikum minash-shaahideen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the One who created them, and I bear witness to that.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَاللّٰهِ لَاَكِيْدَنَّ اَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ اَنْ تُوَلُّوْا مُدْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
ayahs.transliteration: Watallaahi la'akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen
ayahs.translationClear: By Allah, I will have a plan for your statues after you have gone away.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذٰذًا اِلَّا كَبِيْرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ اِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alahum judhaadhan illaa kabeeral lahum la'allahum ilayhi yarji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: So he reduced them into pieces, except for their biggest, that they may return to it.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا مَنْ فَعَلَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا͏ٓ اِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo man fa'ala haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa innahoo laminaz-zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Who did this to our gods? He is certainly one of the wrongdoers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا سَمِعْنَا فَتًي يَّذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهٗٓ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo sami'naa fatan yadhkuruhum yuqaalu lahoo ibraaheem
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We heard a youth mentioning them. He is called Abraham.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا فَاْتُوْا بِهٖ عَلٰٓي اَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."[892]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo fa'too bihee 'alaa a'yunin-naasi la'allahum yashhadoon

footnotes.892: To what they had heard him say. It may also mean "...that they may witness [what will be done to him as punishment]."

ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا ءَاَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هٰذَا بِاٰلِهَتِنَا يٰٓاِبْرٰهِيْمُ ؕ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo a'anta fa'alta haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa yaa'ibraaheem
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Are you the one who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهٗࣗۖ كَبِيْرُهُمْ هٰذَا فَسْـٔ͏َلُوْهُمْ اِنْ كَانُوْا يَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala bal fa'alahoo kabeeruhum haadhaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “But it was this biggest of them that did it. Ask them, if they can speak.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَرَجَعُوْٓا اِلٰٓي اَنْفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّكُمْ اَنْتُمُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Faraja'oo ilaa anfusihim faqaaloo innakum antumuz-zaalimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Then they turned to one another, and said, “You yourselves are the wrongdoers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوْا عَلٰي رُءُوْسِهِمْۚ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ يَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then they reversed themselves,[893] [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma nukisoo 'alaa ru'oosihim laqad 'alimta maa haa'ulaa'i yantiqoon

footnotes.893: After first admitting their error, they were seized by pride and obstinacy.

ayahs.translationClear: But they reverted to their old ideas: “You certainly know that these do not speak.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اَفَتَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَنْفَعُكُمْ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ ؕ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala afata'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shay'an walaa yadurrukum
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Do you worship, instead of Allah, what can neither benefit you in anything, nor harm you?

ayahs.textUthmani: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Uff[894] to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
ayahs.transliteration: Uffil lakum walimaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi afalaa ta'qiloon

footnotes.894: An exclamation of anger and displeasure.

ayahs.translationClear: Fie on you, and on what you worship instead of Allah. Do you not understand?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا حَرِّقُوْهُ وَانْصُرُوْٓا اٰلِهَتَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo harriqoohu wansuroo aalihatakum in kuntum faa'ileen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Burn him and support your gods, if you are going to act.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْنَا يٰنَارُ كُوْنِيْ بَرْدًا وَّسَلٰمًا عَلٰٓي اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
ayahs.transliteration: Qulnaa yaanaaru koonee bardan wasalaaman 'alaa ibraaheem
ayahs.translationClear: We said, “O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَرَادُوْا بِهٖ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنٰهُمُ الْاَخْسَرِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'araadoo bihee kaydan faja'alnaahumul-akhsareen
ayahs.translationClear: They planned to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَجَّيْنٰهُ وَلُوْطًا اِلَي الْاَرْضِ الَّتِيْ بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَا لِلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
ayahs.transliteration: Wanajjaynaahu walootan ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa lil'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: And We delivered him, and Lot, to the land that We blessed for all people.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً‌ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗٓ اِسْحٰقَؕ وَيَعْقُوْبَ نَافِلَةًؕ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: Wawahabnaa lahoo is'haaqa waya'qooba naafilatan wakullan ja'alnaa saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: And We granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift; and each We made righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ‌ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَىِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا وَاَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرٰتِ وَاِقَامَ الصَّلٰوةِ وَاِيْتَا࢜ءَ الزَّكٰوةِۚ وَكَانُوْا لَنَا عٰبِدِيْنَ ۚۙ
ayahs.translation: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnaahum a'immatan yahdoona bi'amrinaa wa'awhaynaa ilayhim fi'lal-khayraati wa'iqaamas-salaati wa'eetaa'az-zakaati wakaanoo lanaa 'aabideen
ayahs.translationClear: And We made them leaders, guiding by Our command; and We inspired them to do good works, and to observe the prayer, and to give out charity. They were devoted servants to Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ‌ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلُوْطًا اٰتَيْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَّعِلْمًا وَّنَجَّيْنٰهُ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِيْ كَانَتْ تَّعْمَلُ الْخَبٰ࢜ىِٕثَؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فٰسِقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.transliteration: Walootan aataynaahu hukman wa'ilman wanajjaynaahu minal-qaryatil-latee kaanat ta'malul-khabaa'itha innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And Lot—We gave him judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the town that practiced the abominations. They were wicked and perverted people.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَدْخَلْنٰهُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'adkhalnaahu fee rahmatinaa innahoo minas-saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: And We admitted him into Our mercy; for he was one of the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنُوْحًا اِذْ نَادٰي مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ فَنَجَّيْنٰهُ وَاَهْلَهٗ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh][895] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
ayahs.transliteration: Wanoohan idh naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjaynaahu wa'ahlahoo minal-karbil-'azeem

footnotes.895: i.e., supplicated against his people who had persisted in denial and animosity. See 71:26-28.

ayahs.translationClear: And Noah, when he called before. So We answered him, and delivered him and his family from the great disaster.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ‌ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَصَرْنٰهُ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِيْنَ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanasarnaahu minal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in fa'aghraqnaahum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: And We supported him against the people who rejected Our signs. They were an evil people, so We drowned them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَدَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ اِذْ يَحْكُمٰنِ فِي الْحَرْثِ اِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيْهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِۚ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شٰهِدِيْنَ ࣗۙ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night],[896] and We were witness to their judgement.
ayahs.transliteration: Wadaawooda wasulaymaana idh yahkumaani fil-harthi idh nafashat feehi ghanamul-qawmi wakunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
ayahs.translationClear: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the case of the field, when some people’s sheep wandered therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ‌ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا‌ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ‌ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَفَهَّمْنٰهَا سُلَيْمٰنَۚ وَكُلًّا اٰتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَّعِلْمًاؗ وَّسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوٗدَ الْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَؕ وَكُنَّا فٰعِلِيْنَ

words.translation: And We gave understanding of it

ayahs.translation: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].[897]
ayahs.transliteration: Fafahhamnaahaa sulaymaana wakullan aataynaa hukman wa'ilman wasakhkharnaa ma'a daawoodal-jibaala yusabbihna wat-tayra wakunnaa faa'ileen

footnotes.897: Meaning that Allāh has always been capable of accomplishing whatever He wills.

ayahs.translationClear: And so We made Solomon understand it, and to each We gave wisdom and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains along with David to sing Our praises, and the birds as well—surely We did.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ‌ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعَلَّمْنٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوْسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بَاْسِكُمْۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ شٰكِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'allamnaahu san'ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum mim ba'sikum fahal antum shaakiroon
ayahs.translationClear: And We taught him the making of shields for you, to protect you from your violence. Are you, then, appreciative?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا‌ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِسُلَيْمٰنَ الرِّيْحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِيْ بِاَمْرِهٖٓ اِلَي الْاَرْضِ الَّتِيْ بٰرَكْنَا فِيْهَاؕ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Walisulaymaanar-reeha 'aasifatan tajree bi'amrihee ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa wakunnaa bikulli shay'in 'aalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And to Solomon the stormy wind, blowing at his command towards the land that We have blessed. We are aware of everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ‌ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطِيْنِ مَنْ يَّغُوْصُوْنَ لَهٗ وَيَعْمَلُوْنَ عَمَلًا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَۚ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حٰفِظِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.[898]
ayahs.transliteration: Waminash-shayaateeni man yaghoosoona lahoo waya'maloona 'amalan doona dhaalika wakunnaa lahum haafizeen

footnotes.898: Preventing any disobedience or deviation by them from Solomon's instructions and protecting him from being harmed by them.

ayahs.translationClear: And of the devils were some that dived for him, and performed other, lesser tasks. But We kept them restrained.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَيُّوْبَ اِذْ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahoo annee massaniyad-durru wa'anta arhamur-raahimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And Job, when he cried out to his Lord: “Great harm has afflicted me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ‌ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهٖ مِنْ ضُرٍّ وَّاٰتَيْنٰهُ اَهْلَهٗ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا وَذِكْرٰي لِلْعٰبِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashafnaa maa bihee min durrin wa'aataynaahu ahlahoo wamithlahum ma'ahum rahmatam min 'indinaa wadhikraa lil'aabideen
ayahs.translationClear: So We answered him, lifted his suffering, and restored his family to him, and their like with them—a mercy from Us, and a reminder for the worshipers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ‌ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِسْمٰعِيْلَ وَاِدْرِيْسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِؕ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصّٰبِرِيْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ismaa'eela wa'idreesa wadhal-kifli kullum minas-saabireen
ayahs.translationClear: And Ishmael, and Enoch, and Ezekiel; each was one of the steadfast.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ‌ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَدْخَلْنٰهُمْ فِيْ رَحْمَتِنَاؕ اِنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'adkhalnaahum fee rahmatinaa innahum minas-saaliheen
ayahs.translationClear: And We admitted them into Our mercy. They were among the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَذَا النُّوْنِ اِذْ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ اَنْ لَّنْ نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادٰي فِي الظُّلُمٰتِ اَنْ لَّا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْتَ سُبْحٰنَكَࣗۖ اِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger[899] and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.[900] And he called out within the darknesses,[901] "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Wadhan-nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fazanna al lan naqdira 'alayhi fanaadaa fiz-zulumaati al laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen

footnotes.899: At the disbelief of his people.
footnotes.900: Or "would not restrict him" in the belly of the fish.
footnotes.901: That of the night, of the sea, and of the fish's interior.

ayahs.translationClear: And Jonah, when he stormed out in fury, thinking We had no power over him. But then he cried out in the darkness, “There is no god but You! Glory to You! I was one of the wrongdoers!”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ‌ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗۙ وَنَجَّيْنٰهُ مِنَ الْغَمِّؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُـْۨجِي الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo wanajjaynaahu minal-ghammi wakadhaalika nunjil-mu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: So We answered him, and saved him from the affliction. Thus We save the faithful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَزَكَرِيَّا͏ٓ اِذْ نَادٰي رَبَّهٗ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فَرْدًا وَّاَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوٰرِثِيْنَ ۚۖ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
ayahs.transliteration: Wazakariyyaa idh naadaa rabbahoo rabbi laa tadharnee fardan wa'anta khayrul-waaritheen
ayahs.translationClear: And Zechariah, when he called out to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone, even though You are the Best of heirs.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ‌ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا‌ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ ۝٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهٗؗ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهٗ يَحْيٰي وَاَصْلَحْنَا لَهٗ زَوْجَهٗؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا يُسٰرِعُوْنَ فِي الْخَيْرٰتِ وَيَدْعُوْنَنَا رَغَبًا وَّرَهَبًاؕ وَكَانُوْا لَنَا خٰشِعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate[902] Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
ayahs.transliteration: Fastajabnaa lahoo wawahabnaa lahoo yahyaa wa'aslahnaa lahoo zawjahoo innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wayad'oonanaa raghaban warahaban wakaanoo lanaa khaashi'een
ayahs.translationClear: So We answered him, and gave him John. And We cured his wife for him. They used to vie in doing righteous deeds, and used to call on Us in love and awe, and they used to humble themselves to Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٩١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّتِيْٓ اَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ رُّوْحِنَا وَجَعَلْنٰهَا وَابْنَهَا͏ٓ اٰيَةً لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir roohinaa waja'alnaahaa wabnahaa aayatal lil'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: And she who guarded her virginity. We breathed into her of Our spirit, and made her and her son a sign to the world.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖٓ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةًؗۖ وَّاَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,[903] and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haadhihee ummatukum ummatan waahidatan wa'ana rabbukum fa'budoon

footnotes.903: i.e., a collective way of life or course of conduct followed by a community.

ayahs.translationClear: This community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ‌ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَقَطَّعُوْٓا اَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْؕ كُلٌّ اِلَيْنَا رٰجِعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves,[904] [but] all to Us will return.
ayahs.transliteration: Wataqatta'oo amrahum baynahum kullun ilaynaa raaji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: But they splintered themselves into factions. They will all return to Us.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ ۝٩٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهٖۚ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ كٰتِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort,[905] and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
ayahs.transliteration: Faman ya'mal minas-saalihaati wahuwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yihee wa'innaa lahoo kaatiboon

footnotes.905: Such a person will not be deprived of his due reward.

ayahs.translationClear: Whoever does righteous deeds, and is a believer, his effort will not be denied. We are writing it down for him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٩٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلٰي قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنٰهَا͏ٓ اَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return[906]
ayahs.transliteration: Waharaamun 'alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaa annahum laa yarji'oon

footnotes.906: They cannot return to this world, nor can they repent to Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: There is a ban on the town that We had destroyed—that they will not return.

ayahs.textUthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ ۝٩٦
ayahs.textIndopak: حَتّٰٓي اِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَاْجُوْجُ وَمَاْجُوْجُ وَهُمْ مِّنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَّنْسِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
ayahs.transliteration: Hattaa idhaa futihat ya'jooju wama'jooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloon
ayahs.translationClear: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they swarm down from every mound.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاقْتَرَبَ الْوَعْدُ الْحَقُّ فَاِذَا هِيَ شَاخِصَةٌ اَبْصَارُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاؕ يٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِيْ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqtarabal-wa'dul-haqqu fa'idhaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul-ladheena kafaroo yaawaylanaa qad kunnaa fee ghaflatim min haadhaa bal kunnaa zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: The promise of truth has drawn near. The eyes of those who disbelieved will stare in horror: “Woe to us. We were oblivious to this. In fact, we were wrongdoers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ ۝٩٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَؕ اَنْتُمْ لَهَا وٰرِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
ayahs.transliteration: Innakum wamaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi hasabu jahannama antum lahaa waaridoon
ayahs.translationClear: You and what you worship besides Allah are fuel for Hell. You will descend into it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا‌ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ ۝٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْ كَانَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ اٰلِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوْهَاؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
ayahs.transliteration: Law kaana haa'ulaa'i aalihatam maa waradoohaa wakullun feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.translationClear: Had these been gods, they would not have descended into it. All will abide in it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ ۝١٠٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهُمْ فِيْهَا زَفِيْرٌ وَّهُمْ فِيْهَا لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
ayahs.transliteration: Lahum feehaa zafeerun wahum feehaa laa yasma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: In it they will wail. In it they will not hear.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ ۝١٠١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُمْ مِّنَّا الْحُسْنٰٓيۙ اُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal-ladheena sabaqat lahum minnal-husnaa ulaa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who deserved goodness from Us—these will be kept away from it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا‌ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ ۝١٠٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ حَسِيْسَهَاۚ وَهُمْ فِيْ مَا اشْتَهَتْ اَنْفُسُهُمْ خٰلِدُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yasma'oona haseesahaa wahum fee mashtahat anfusuhum khaalidoon
ayahs.translationClear: They will not hear its hissing, and they will forever abide in what their hearts desire.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ ۝١٠٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْاَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُؕ هٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror,[907] and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yahzunuhumul-faza'ul-akbaru watatalaqqaahumul-malaa'ikatu haadhaa yawmukumul-ladhee kuntum too'adoon

footnotes.907: The events of the Last Hour or of the Resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: The Supreme Fear will not worry them, and the angels will receive them: “This is your Day which you were promised.”

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ‌ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ‌ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ‌ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ ۝١٠٤
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَا࢜ءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِؕ كَمَا بَدَاْنَا͏ٓ اَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيْدُهٗؕ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَاؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا فٰعِلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.[908]
