ayahs.transliteration: Yawma natwis-samaa'a katayyis-sijilli lilkutubi kamaa bada'naa awwala khalqin nu'eeduhoo wa'dan 'alaynaa innaa kunnaa faa'ileen

footnotes.908: More literally, "Indeed, We are ever doers" of what We will.

ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when We fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as We began the first creation, We will repeat it—a promise binding on Us. We will act.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ ۝١٠٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِي الزَّبُوْرِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ الذِّكْرِ اَنَّ الْاَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ الصّٰلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms][909] after the [previous] mention[910] that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad katabnaa fiz-zaboori mim ba'didh-dhikri annal-arda yarithuhaa 'ibaadiyas-saalihoon

footnotes.909: Az-Zabūr can also mean "scriptures" in general.
footnotes.910: i.e., the Torah. The "mention" may also refer to the original inscription with Allāh, i.e., the Preserved Slate (al-Lawḥ al-Maḥfūẓ).

ayahs.translationClear: We have written in the Psalms, after the Reminder, that the earth will be inherited by My righteous servants.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ ۝١٠٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ هٰذَا لَبَلٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عٰبِدِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna fee haadhaa labalaaghal liqawmin 'aabideen
ayahs.translationClear: Indeed, in this is a message for people who worship.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝١٠٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ اِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa rahmatal lil'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: We did not send you except as mercy to mankind.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ‌ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ ۝١٠٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ اِنَّمَا يُوْحٰٓي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا͏ٓ اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَهَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qul innamaa yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun fahal antum muslimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “It is revealed to me that your god is One God. Are you going to submit?”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ‌ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ ۝١٠٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ اٰذَنْتُكُمْ عَلٰي سَوَا࢜ءٍؕ وَاِنْ اَدْرِيْٓ اَقَرِيْبٌ اَمْ بَعِيْدٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally.[911] And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'in tawallaw faqul aadhantukum 'alaa sawaa'in wa'in adree aqareebun am ba'eedum maa too'adoon

footnotes.911: The Prophet (ﷺ) made this message known to all people, not concealing any of it from anyone or preferring any group over another.

ayahs.translationClear: But if they turn away, say, “I have informed you sufficiently. Although I do not know whether what you are promised is near or far.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ ۝١١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّهٗ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
ayahs.transliteration: Innahoo ya'lamul-jahra minal-qawli waya'lamu maa taktumoon
ayahs.translationClear: He knows what is said openly, and He knows what you conceal.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ ۝١١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ اَدْرِيْ لَعَلَّهٗ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَاعٌ اِلٰي حِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And I know not; perhaps it[912] is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in adree la'allahoo fitnatul lakum wamataa'un ilaa heen
ayahs.translationClear: “And I do not know whether it is perhaps a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ‌ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ ۝١١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قٰلَ رَبِّ احْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّؕ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوْنَ ࣖ

words.translation: the One Whose help is sought

ayahs.translation: [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."[913]
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbihkum bil-haqqi warabbunar-rahmaanul-musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, judge with justice.” And, “Our Lord is the Gracious, whose help is sought against what you allege.”
